items.reason: This concerns indefinite-length ASN.1 integers causing NegativeArraySizeException in ASN1Decoder, distinct from #07's missing JOSE signature-length validation in concatenatedRSToASN1DER.
It identifies the same contract mismatch: getBouncyCastleProvider returns the default JDK KeyStore provider rather than BouncyCastle, despite suggesting a documentation fix.
It identifies the same use of default P-256 keys for ES384 and ES512, leaving larger-curve signatures untested. The broader comment also includes #11's lack of independent signature verification.
It identifies the same two discarded ASN1Encoder writes, which duplicate encoding performed in the return statement.
